attrs.mechanism: Agent hypothesis: add 0.10 times a bounded, scaled current-item embedding to each valid final state. The generated control adds the same signal after a fixed half-width circular rotation of feature coordinates. Rotation preserves each signal's norm and item information while disrupting its direct coordinate alignment with the tied scoring embeddings.
prerequisites: Host source admission and CPU contracts pass before any fit.
Candidate and control use independent fresh initialization for each category at seed 42.
Host costing confirms that all required candidate and generated-control fits plus overhead fit the reserved budget.
tensor_constraints: Keep input IDs unchanged and encode_sequence output causal with shape [B,L,D], original dtype and device.
Compute the added signal from item_emb(seq), scaled by sqrt(D), bounded with the incumbent 4*tanh(z/4) form, and masked to zero at padding positions.
Use a fixed coefficient 0.10 in both arms. In the control, circularly rotate feature coordinates by floor(D/2) using concatenation; add no learnable parameters.
Retain the existing 0.85/0.15 current-state and strictly preceding-context computation, including its no-predecessor fallback.
Keep forward and score_candidates unchanged so both score the same final encoded representations.
